citation_entries.sentence: Among us, belonging asked a share of what a person owned, and for some it asked suffering.
Cyprian wrote a whole treatise on almsgiving, much of it aimed at believers who had money.
He told them their wealth was for sharing with Christ, and he called almsgiving the ordinary remedy for sin after baptism.
Those who confessed Christ under questioning and suffered for it held that their suffering gave them standing to ask peace for others.
Our sayings tell of our bishop Cyprian and his people in hard times:
A dreadful plague broke out and killed countless people every day.
Everyone fled the infection, and they even put their own dying friends out of their homes.
When we gathered, our bishop told us that there was nothing special about caring only for our own people.
We had to love even our enemies and pray for those who persecute us.
So good was done to everyone, not only to our own people.
Our deacon Pontius judged that more was done here than in the story of Tobias, who had gathered the dead of his own people only.

text:
Among us, belonging asked a share of what a person owned, and for some it asked suffering. Cyprian wrote a whole treatise on almsgiving, much of it aimed at believers who had money. He told them their wealth was for sharing with Christ, and he called almsgiving the ordinary remedy for sin after baptism. Those who confessed Christ under questioning and suffered for it held that their suffering gave them standing to ask peace for others. Our sayings tell of our bishop Cyprian and his people in hard times:

A dreadful plague broke out and killed countless people every day. Everyone fled the infection, and they even put their own dying friends out of their homes.

When we gathered, our bishop told us that there was nothing special about caring only for our own people. We had to love even our enemies and pray for those who persecute us.

So good was done to everyone, not only to our own people. Our deacon Pontius judged that more was done here than in the story of Tobias, who had gathered the dead of his own people only.
